static_traits.name: Lin Rui
static_traits.social_status: 有一位最好的朋友Cayden，平时遇到困难可以倾诉，但关于此次拒信事件尚not yet与任何人交流；同学与其他关系Not mentioned
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；以往not yet因拒绝相关问题求助；without既往心理咨询或治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe emotions and automatic thoughts; low tone, marked sense of shame; under guidance able to reflect and accept alternative explanations; fairly high cooperation; cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, mental filtering, and mind reading present

basic_info.main_problem: Received a rejection letter from a gifted program后，觉得名誉受损，持续反复思考这一事件并感到Low mood。
basic_info.core_demands: 因被拒信扰动和“名誉被毁”的想法感到overwhelmed，希望通过咨询学习应对与调节这些情绪与想法。
growth_experiences: Academic side has had positive experiences: excellent mathematics grades last semester, won a spelling competition last year. These achievements reinforce their self-schema of 'being seen as smart / maintaining high standards' and the sense of others' expectations.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/not够好。
My worth depends on others' evaluations of me.

special_situations.event: Received a rejection letter from a gifted program
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not被录取，就说明I am not smart enough，名誉会被毁。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以完美/全或without标准要求自己，事后反复思考失败并回避与他人谈论以避免羞耻。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的名誉完了；I am not smart enough。

special_situations.event: 想到同学或朋友会知道他not yet被录取（尚not yet收到他人实际反馈）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我的失败，他们一定会看not起我。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids communicating with friends (such as Cayden), keeps silent to avoid being evaluated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得I am not good enough/not够聪明。

special_situations.event: In his mind, uses this rejection letter to judge his academic ability and 'smart' identity
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One important failure can define my overall ability and worth.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以“要么被录取要么就是not聪明”的标准评判自我，用单次结果标签化自己。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果这次have not进，我就not算聪明。

special_situations.event: When recalling past achievements (such as math grades and spelling competitions), attention still stays only on this rejection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 其他成就都not重要，这次结果才说明我的真实水平。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视正向证据，持续聚焦负面事件以自我证明‘not够好’的信念。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些成绩not算数，这次才是关键。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被视为聪明、维持Good名誉
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与羞辱、被看低、失去价值感
defense_goal: Avoids exposing vulnerability and failure information to maintain self-image
通过全或without标准维持可控与完美的自我叙事

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily judged and possibly a failure
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/看not起自己的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of disclosing the rejection letter to his good friend Cayden or others, or when asked by others about the application result
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会看not起我、negate我的能力（移情：将内在Self-doubtProjection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以含糊与回避的方式回应，如“not什么”“not想说”，降低自我暴露，语气谨慎、简短。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others affirm her past achievements and try to balance her view
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 这次拒信更重要、其它成就not足以证明我有能力
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use理性解释强调此次结果的决定性，用“这次not一样/更重要”等陈述negate正面证据，语气坚决但低落。

manifestations: 害怕被看not起而not愿向他人（包括最好的朋友Cayden）透露拒信
Imagines others as negative judges and chooses to bear the shame and frustration alone
持续Self-denial，弱化与他人的真实连接与支持
outcomes: Increased subjective sense of isolation，支持系统not yet被激活
学习Decreased drive、对自我价值的怀疑加剧

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 担心“显得软弱”，Suppressing expression需要与情绪
在与朋友交流前过度评估风险，迟迟not愿开启对话

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 认为同学和朋友会看not起他，即使have not实际证据
Uses 'others will evaluate negatively' as a reason to avoid seeking help and honesty

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Takes the standard 'must be admitted to count as smart / respectable' as the sole basis of evaluation
Defines overall self-worth by a single outcome

positive_force: Has stable social support (best friend Cayden), can obtain support when needed
Has past academic achievements (excellent mathematics results, won a spelling competition), possessing evidence of real ability
Able to clearly express emotions and thoughts, willing to seek help
Under guidance, able to conduct evidence examination and alternative thinking, with the potential to adjust cognitions
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and mental filtering are evident
Highly dependent on external evaluation (reputation / others' opinions) to determine self-worth
Avoids disclosure and seeking support, leading to subjective isolation and maintained emotions
对单次失败的过度重要化，弱化正向证据，Reinforcement失败叙事

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly ponders the rejection letter event and makes negative self-evaluations (rumination)
antecedent: Sees or thinks of cues related to the genius program and application
Being alone时回忆收到拒信的场景
target_behavior.core_reason: 对名誉受损的灾难化认知以及“单次失败即可定义全部能力”的全或without信念
target_behavior.function: In the short term, tries to gain a sense of control and explanation through rumination, but actually avoids direct emotional processing and help-seeking
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood持续、注意和Decreased drive，影响学习兴趣

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding disclosing rejection and seeking support from others (especially one's good friend Cayden)
antecedent: When thinking of telling friends or being asked by others about application results
与同学/朋友互动前的Anticipation担忧
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被看低与羞耻，将Self-denialProjection为他人负面评价
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Increased subjective sense of isolation，支持系统not yet被激活，痛苦维持

target_behavior.behavior: Verbal/cognitive judgment defining overall academic ability by a single rejection
antecedent: When academic identity or achievement topics come up
When comparing past achievements with current setbacks
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization，外部验证取向强
target_behavior.function: 为当前情绪与Self-doubt提供看似一致的解释框架（Rationalization）
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、学习Decreased motivation，进一步Reinforcement负性自我图式
